queue_entries.zh: 一小量酒或油（quartillo的確切容量未核）
queue_entries.en: A small measure of wine or oil (the exact capacity of quartillo is unverified).

queue_entries.source_L: que es eso? modillo〔後詞讀形可候modillo；此用法未定〕
queue_entries.zh: 那是什麼？（後詞modillo用法未定，未譯盡）
queue_entries.en: What is that? (The following modillo remains unresolved, so the whole unit is not fully translated.)

queue_entries.source_L: quebrada q̃ baja al mar
queue_entries.zh: 下通大海的溝壑〔q̃縮寫不展開〕
queue_entries.en: A ravine descending to the sea [q̃ is left unexpanded].

queue_entries.source_L: Quebradico
queue_entries.zh: 〔暫不譯：Quebradico的詞義未定，不逕改成近形詞〕
queue_entries.en: [Translation withheld: the sense of Quebradico is unresolved; it is not silently replaced by a similar word.]

queue_entries.source_L: Quebradura qᵉ〔q上小e形，不展開〕 mella
queue_entries.zh: 破損、缺口〔mella亦指缺口；qᵉ的接續作用未展開〕
queue_entries.en: Breakage or a notch; mella also refers to a notch [the connecting function of qᵉ is unexpanded].

queue_entries.source_L: Quebrado, 〔上回環、下伸長幹的縮寫；舊候選ƒ，未定，不展開〕. potra
queue_entries.zh: 破裂／受損的〔Quebrado〕；potra詞義及中間縮寫未定
queue_entries.en: Broken or damaged [Quebrado]; the sense of potra and the intervening abbreviation remain unresolved.

queue_entries.source_L: Quebrar. cosa qbrada〔可見省寫，不補ue〕
queue_entries.zh: 打破、折斷；cosa後qbrada為省寫，暫不展開完整詞形
queue_entries.en: To break; the abbreviated qbrada after cosa is left unexpanded.

queue_entries.source_L: quebrar partiendo ut pan &ᵃ
queue_entries.zh: 掰開而使之斷裂，如麵包〔末&ᵃ不展開〕
queue_entries.en: To break by splitting, as with bread [&ᵃ left unexpanded].

queue_entries.source_L: quebrarse la frente, hacerse / las cej〔a/o形未定〕s, labrarse la frente
queue_entries.zh: 額頭破裂／受損；hacerse las cej〔a/o〕s片段未定；在額頭上加工／刻作〔labrarse的具體用法未定〕
queue_entries.en: To break or injure one’s forehead; the hacerse las cej[a/o]s segment is unresolved; to work or carve on one’s forehead [the precise use of labrarse is unresolved].

queue_entries.source_L: quebrar el bullicio la ca〔後接連筆未定；候選caueza，舊casa不作定讀〕, / que no puede salir
queue_entries.zh: quebrar：打破／損傷；el bullicio：喧鬧；其後la ca…連筆及全句接續未定；que no puede salir：不能出去
queue_entries.en: Quebrar: to break or damage; el bullicio: commotion; the following la ca… string and the sentence connection are unresolved; que no puede salir: cannot get out.

queue_entries.source_L: quedarse con lo peor agrauián / dole
queue_entries.zh: 留下較差的一份，因而使某人受損／受委屈〔誰留下、誰受損的關係未明，不據H改成較好〕
queue_entries.en: To keep the worse portion, thereby wronging someone [who keeps it and who is wronged remain unclear; peor is not changed to better from H].

queue_entries.source_L: [圈] quedarse con lo peor agrauián / dole
queue_entries.zh: 留下較差的一份，因而使某人受損／受委屈〔誰留下、誰受損的關係未明，不據H改成較好〕
queue_entries.en: To keep the worse portion, thereby wronging someone [who keeps it and who is wronged remain unclear; peor is not changed to better from H].

queue_entries.source_L: quedarse elado, ut qᵉ〔q上小e樣回環，不展開〕 esperaba / algo y le sucedio del reues
queue_entries.zh: 愣住、如凍住一般；原文舉例為期待某事，結果卻相反〔qᵉ縮寫未展開〕
queue_entries.en: To be left frozen or stunned; the example concerns expecting something and having the opposite happen [qᵉ is unexpanded].

queue_entries.source_L: Quemar - q̃〔下伸q樣幹、上e樣小筆；舊記號保留，不展開〕 fuego.
queue_entries.zh: 燒、焚燒；fuego：火〔中間縮寫未展開〕
queue_entries.en: To burn; fuego: fire [intervening abbreviation unexpanded].

queue_entries.source_L: quemar, picar como la pimienta / henhible[?], mostaça &ᵃ
queue_entries.zh: 產生灼辣感，如胡椒、henhible[?]、芥末〔未定詞與尾縮記保留〕
queue_entries.en: To burn or sting, as pepper, henhible[?], and mustard do [uncertain word and final abbreviated mark retained].

queue_entries.source_L: quemar, dar botones de fuego
queue_entries.zh: 燒灼；施加botones de fuego〔該歷史詞組未定〕
queue_entries.en: To burn; to apply botones de fuego [the historical phrase remains unresolved].

queue_entries.source_L: quemadura de arroz q̃〔下伸q樣幹、上e樣小筆；舊記號保留，不展開〕 se / pega a la olla
queue_entries.zh: 燒焦的米飯；粘在鍋上〔中間縮寫未展開〕
queue_entries.en: Burnt rice; sticking to the pot [the connecting abbreviation is unexpanded].

queue_entries.source_L: quenta de ambar pᵃ reumas[?]
queue_entries.zh: 琥珀珠；後接pᵃ reumas[?]未定段
queue_entries.en: An amber bead; followed by the unresolved segment pᵃ reumas[?].

queue_entries.source_L: [圈] quenta de ambar pᵃ reumas[?]
queue_entries.zh: 琥珀珠；後接pᵃ reumas[?]未定段
queue_entries.en: An amber bead; followed by the unresolved segment pᵃ reumas[?].

queue_entries.source_L: Querer. q̃〔下伸q樣幹、上e樣小筆；舊記號保留，不展開〕 desear.
queue_entries.zh: 想要、願意；desear：希望、想要〔中間縮寫未展〕
queue_entries.en: To want or wish; desear: to desire [intervening abbreviation unexpanded].

queue_entries.source_L: Queso - q〔右上獨立小e形；縮寫未展〕 leche
queue_entries.zh: 乳酪；牛奶（中間q上小e的縮寫及連接未展）
queue_entries.en: Cheese; milk (the intervening q with a small raised e and its connection are unexpanded).

queue_entries.source_L: queso fresco como torteros〔中段連筆/整詞未定，舊候讀原留〕 / que benden
queue_entries.zh: 出售的新鮮乳酪，像……（torteros候詞未定，不補比喻物）
queue_entries.en: Fresh cheese that is sold, like … (the tentative word torteros is unresolved; the comparison is not supplied).

queue_entries.source_L: 〔圈〕quien es ola?
queue_entries.zh: 是誰？（ola的呼語用法候讀，未定）
queue_entries.en: Who is it? (ola may be a call or address; its use is unresolved).

queue_entries.source_L: quien saue si〔後有o樣連筆，分讀未定〕 mi coraçon esta / triste?
queue_entries.zh: 候義：誰知道我的心是否悲傷？（saue si後連筆與句間聯繫未定）
queue_entries.en: Tentative: Who knows whether my heart is sad? (The join after saue si and the connection of the clauses remain uncertain.)

queue_entries.source_L: Quilites
queue_entries.zh: 候義：可食青菜（Quilites讀形/所指未核，不指定植物種）
queue_entries.en: Tentative: edible greens (the reading and referent of Quilites are unverified; no species is assigned).

queue_entries.source_L: 〔圈〕quilites
queue_entries.zh: 候義：可食青菜（quilites讀形/所指未核，不指定植物種）
queue_entries.en: Tentative: edible greens (the reading and referent of quilites are unverified; no species is assigned).

queue_entries.source_L: quitarse el sombrero q〔上小a形，字干交筆，亦可能p形；縮寫未展〕 poner / lo en su lugar
queue_entries.zh: 脫帽；把它放在原處（中間縮寫及連接未定）
queue_entries.en: To take off the hat; to put it in its place (the intervening abbreviation and connection remain unresolved).

queue_entries.source_L: raçon es, bien fuera &c. ~
queue_entries.zh: 這是合乎道理的；那樣會是好的〔具體語氣與時序未定；原&c.不展開〕
queue_entries.en: It is reasonable; it would be good [the precise mood and timing are unresolved; the source’s &c. is unexpanded].

queue_entries.source_L: raçon fuera q̃ lo supieses &c.
queue_entries.zh: 你知道才合乎道理〔具體語氣與時序未定；q̃及&c.不展開〕
queue_entries.en: It would be reasonable for you to know [the precise mood and timing are unresolved; q̃ and &c. are unexpanded].

queue_entries.source_L: raçon verdadera q̃ tiene / mucha fuerça ~
queue_entries.zh: 真切而有力的理由〔q̃不展開〕
queue_entries.en: A true reason or argument with great force [q̃ unexpanded].

queue_entries.source_L: Rajar. 〔q樣下伸長幹、上回環縮寫，舊q̃候選，不展開〕. Partir.
queue_entries.zh: 劈開；分開〔中間縮寫未定，不展開〕
queue_entries.en: To split; to divide [the intervening abbreviation is unresolved and unexpanded].

queue_entries.source_L: rala cosa ~ como arboles &c.
queue_entries.zh: 稀疏的，如樹木〔末&c.不展開〕
queue_entries.en: Sparse, as trees may be [&c. left unexpanded].

queue_entries.source_L: ralo como manta, paño &c.
queue_entries.zh: 疏鬆、稀薄的，如毯子、布料〔末&c.不展開〕
queue_entries.en: Thin or loosely woven, as a blanket or cloth [&c. left unexpanded].

queue_entries.source_L: Rallar ~ [上補 rallo〔疑〕] q̃ desmenuçar deshacer.
queue_entries.zh: 擦碎／刨碎；弄成碎屑、拆散〔上補rallo候選及q̃未解，不補成工具名〕
queue_entries.en: To grate or shred; to crumble or break apart [the added rallo candidate and q̃ remain unresolved; no tool name supplied].

queue_entries.source_L: Ramada pᵃ〔p上小a形，不展開〕 el sol
queue_entries.zh: 遮陽的枝葉棚〔pᵃ縮寫不展開〕
queue_entries.en: A shelter of branches for shade from the sun [pᵃ is unexpanded].

queue_entries.source_L: Ramera. 〔q樣下伸長幹、上回環縮寫，舊q̃候選，不展開〕. puta ~
queue_entries.zh: 妓女；puta為貶稱〔中間縮寫未定，不展開〕
queue_entries.en: A prostitute; puta is derogatory [the intervening abbreviation is unresolved and unexpanded].

queue_entries.source_L: Rara cosa q̃ preciosa ~ [q̃ 重描，疑]
queue_entries.zh: 稀有、珍貴的東西〔q̃重描候選未展開〕
queue_entries.en: A rare, precious thing [the overwritten q̃ candidate is unexpanded].

queue_entries.source_L: ra cosa pocas veces vista ~
queue_entries.zh: 很少見到的東西〔原ra省寫不補成完整詞形〕
queue_entries.en: A thing seldom seen [the source’s shortened ra is not expanded].

queue_entries.source_L: raro q̃ no se halla ~
queue_entries.zh: 稀少、難找到〔q縮寫未展〕
queue_entries.en: Rare; not found [q abbreviation unexpanded].

queue_entries.source_L: raro, q̃ no se halla ~〔L獨圈〕
queue_entries.zh: 稀少、難找到〔q縮寫未展〕
queue_entries.en: Rare; not found [q abbreviation unexpanded].

queue_entries.source_L: raro q̃ raras veces lo ay ~
queue_entries.zh: 稀有；很少有〔q縮寫未展〕
queue_entries.en: Rare; seldom present or available [q abbreviation unexpanded].

queue_entries.source_L: rascar con la punta del dedo 〔連接詞呈ut樣兩筆；舊候選vel，未定〕 / pueril. [末字疑；末段越入H側]
queue_entries.zh: 用指尖搔抓〔後續ut/vel及pueril候選未定〕
queue_entries.en: To scratch with the tip of a finger [following ut/vel and pueril candidates unresolved].

queue_entries.source_L: Rasero p̃〔上a樣小筆；舊記號保留，未展開〕 medir ~
queue_entries.zh: 刮平尺；medir：量度〔中間縮寫未展〕
queue_entries.en: A strickle or levelling stick; medir: to measure [intervening abbreviation unexpanded].

queue_entries.source_L: rastro p̃〔上a樣小筆；舊記號保留，未展開〕 la sementera.
queue_entries.zh: 農耙；播種〔中間縮寫未展〕
queue_entries.en: A rake; sowing [intervening abbreviation unexpanded].

queue_entries.source_L: rastro p̃〔上a樣小筆；舊記號保留，未展開〕 limpiar ierba.
queue_entries.zh: 耙；清理草〔中間縮寫未展〕
queue_entries.en: A rake; clearing grass [intervening abbreviation unexpanded].

queue_entries.source_L: Ratero, vil. / q̃. apocado, baxo. ~
queue_entries.zh: 卑微、低下；怯懦、卑怯〔連接縮寫未展〕
queue_entries.en: Base or lowly; timid or abject [connecting abbreviation unexpanded].

queue_entries.source_L: raya de aljofar ~
queue_entries.zh: 與小粒珍珠相關的線紋或痕跡〔確切所指未定〕
queue_entries.en: A line or mark associated with seed pearls [exact reference unresolved].

queue_entries.source_L: raiz, origen ~ q〔右上獨立小e形；縮寫未展〕 principio.
queue_entries.zh: 根；起源；開端（中間q上小e縮寫及連接未展）
queue_entries.en: Root; origin; beginning (the intervening q with a raised e and its connection remain unexpanded).

queue_entries.source_L: raiz de junquillo olorosa.
queue_entries.zh: 芳香的junquillo之根（植物名保留，種屬未核）
queue_entries.en: The root of an aromatic junquillo; the plant name is retained and no species is established.

queue_entries.source_L: Rebatiña q〔右上獨立小e/c形；縮寫未展〕 hurtar.〔末詞跨L/H〕
queue_entries.zh: 爭搶；偷取（中間縮寫與兩義關係未定）
queue_entries.en: Scrambling to take; stealing (the intervening abbreviation and relation between the senses remain unresolved).

queue_entries.source_L: Rebellion〔亦候Rebellin；中後o/連筆與詞義未定〕 de la mu- / ralla ~
queue_entries.zh: 候讀Rebellion/Rebellin；「城牆的……」（詞形及此處義未定，不補工事名）
queue_entries.en: Tentative Rebellion/Rebellin; “… of the wall” (the word and its sense here remain unresolved; no fortification term is supplied).

queue_entries.source_L: reboltoso mal tercero ~
queue_entries.zh: 惹事；不良的第三方／居間者（mal tercero此處用法未核，不補職銜或特定角色）
queue_entries.en: Troublesome; a harmful third party or intermediary (the use of mal tercero here is unverified; no specific role or title is supplied).

queue_entries.source_L: reboltoso q〔右上獨立小e形；縮寫未展〕 pleitista, perjudicial ~
queue_entries.zh: 惹事；好訴訟而有害的（中間小e縮寫連接未展）
queue_entries.en: Troublesome; litigious and harmful (the intervening raised-e abbreviation and connection remain unexpanded).

queue_entries.source_L: rebolver andar alrededor / o como arbol〔末詞連筆/字讀未定〕 ~
queue_entries.zh: 轉動／繞行；如……（末arbol候詞未定，不補比喻物）
queue_entries.en: To turn or go around; like … (the final tentative arbol is unresolved; the comparison is not supplied).

queue_entries.source_L: rebolver como agua〔字串候讀；與後文關係未定，不補aguja〕 en / madera ~
queue_entries.zh: 候義：轉動／纏繞，如agua……在木材中（字串及比喻關係未定，不補針）
queue_entries.en: Tentative: to turn or wind, like agua … in wood (the word and comparison remain unresolved; no needle is supplied).

queue_entries.source_L: Recaer. q̃. enfermedad ~
queue_entries.zh: 病情復發（縮寫的連接未展）
queue_entries.en: To relapse in illness (the abbreviation and its connection remain unexpanded).

queue_entries.source_L: Reçar 〔G889.13劃刪entre dientes〕 q〔右上獨立小e形；縮寫未展〕 hablar
queue_entries.zh: 誦禱；說話（中間縮寫關係未定；「低聲／咕噥」片語原已劃刪）
queue_entries.en: To recite prayers; to speak (the intervening abbreviation is unresolved; the phrase “under one’s breath” is struck out in the source).

queue_entries.source_L: recivir lo q̃ yo doy.
queue_entries.zh: 接受我所給的東西〔q̃不展開；保留yo的施予者角色〕
queue_entries.en: To receive what I give [q̃ unexpanded; I remains the giver].

queue_entries.source_L: recivir lo q̃ me dan ~〔本欄有獨立圈〕
queue_entries.zh: 接受別人給我的東西〔q̃不展開；保留me的接受者角色〕
queue_entries.en: To receive what people give me [q̃ unexpanded; me remains the recipient].

queue_entries.source_L: recivir la [後刪字未辨清]〔粗刪線覆recivir後半、la附近及後串，並有橫筆延到下行上方；刪筆不復活，精確刪除範圍未定〕
queue_entries.zh: 〔有劃刪的片段〕可辨recivir la：接受……；後續刪串未定，不譯出或復活為有效正文
queue_entries.en: [Partly crossed-out span] The legible recivir la indicates receiving something; the following deleted sequence is unresolved and is neither translated nor restored as active text.

queue_entries.source_L: recivir tributo ~ 〔vtel/ut el樣連寫候選，字幹及分詞未定；舊vtl，不規範展開〕 encomendero
queue_entries.zh: 收取貢賦；encomendero保留歷史稱謂，前接連串及角色接續未定，不補制度細節
queue_entries.en: To receive tribute; encomendero is retained as the historical title, while the preceding sequence and role connection remain unresolved; no institutional details are added.

queue_entries.source_L: recivir Dios el sacriffº
queue_entries.zh: 由神接受某物〔原賓語縮寫sacriffº不展開〕
queue_entries.en: For God to receive something [the abbreviated object sacriffº is left unexpanded].

queue_entries.source_L: recivir dinero pᵃ〔p樣下伸幹、上小a形，不展開〕 emplear..
queue_entries.zh: 接收錢款供運用〔pᵃ不展開；具體用途未定〕
queue_entries.en: To receive money to employ or put to use [pᵃ is unexpanded; the particular use is unspecified].

queue_entries.source_L: recivir algo despues de otro co / mo el q̃ sucede en el offº.
queue_entries.zh: 在另一人之後接手某物，如接替者……〔q̃及offº未展開，未補完整職銜〕
queue_entries.en: To receive something after another person, as one who succeeds another… [q̃ and offº are unexpanded; no complete office title supplied].

queue_entries.source_L: recivir lo q̃ yo doy ~
queue_entries.zh: 接受我所給的東西〔q̃不展開；我為給予者〕
queue_entries.en: To receive what I give [q̃ unexpanded; I is the giver].

queue_entries.source_L: recivir dadiuas o lo q̃ me / dan ~
queue_entries.zh: 接受禮物，或別人給我的東西〔q̃不展開〕
queue_entries.en: To receive gifts, or what people give me [q̃ unexpanded].

queue_entries.source_L: Reclamo pᵃ〔p樣下伸幹、上小a形，不展開〕 caçar q̃ es vn / pajarillo ~
queue_entries.zh: 用於獵捕的誘鳥／引誘物，這裡指一隻小鳥〔pᵃ及q̃不展開〕
queue_entries.en: A hunting lure or decoy, here a little bird [pᵃ and q̃ are unexpanded].

queue_entries.source_L: recoger lo q̃ sera de probecho.
queue_entries.zh: 收集將會有用的東西〔q̃不展開〕
queue_entries.en: To gather what will be useful [q̃ unexpanded].

queue_entries.source_L: reconciliarse pᵃ〔p樣下伸幹、上小a形，不展開〕 / comulgar [插寫]
queue_entries.zh: 為領聖餐而和解／修和〔pᵃ不展開；不推定具體禮儀程序〕
queue_entries.en: To be reconciled for receiving Communion [pᵃ unexpanded; no particular ritual procedure inferred].

queue_entries.source_L: Recto, Justo ~ 〔後細字舊候選vna de lo q̃ [細字疑]；全串未定，延入H側；q樣下伸筆上有e樣小筆，不展開〕
queue_entries.zh: 正直、公正〔後續細字串未定〕
queue_entries.en: Upright and just [following small-letter string unresolved].

queue_entries.source_L: Reusar〔中段字母重描，舊候選保留〕 el officio ~〔L獨圈〕
queue_entries.zh: 推辭職務〔依Reusar舊候選；中段字母重描未定〕
queue_entries.en: To decline an office or duty [based on the retained Reusar candidate; overwritten middle letters unresolved].

queue_entries.source_L: Rigorosa cosa riguroz〔尾串候選，字尾及接筆未定〕. / q〔下伸q樣，上長環接筆；舊id候選，縮寫未定不展開〕 condicion
queue_entries.zh: 嚴厲、嚴格的事物；性情〔riguroz樣尾串及縮寫未定，不補其完整關係〕
queue_entries.en: A rigorous or severe thing; disposition [the riguroz-like sequence and abbreviation remain unresolved; their full relation is not supplied].

queue_entries.source_L: Rimero. q〔下伸q樣，上長環接筆；舊id候選，縮寫未定不展開〕. monton.
queue_entries.zh: 堆、堆積物〔中間縮寫未定，兩詞連接不展開〕
queue_entries.en: A heap or pile [the intervening abbreviation is unresolved and is not expanded].

queue_entries.source_L: Rio, estero ~
queue_entries.zh: 河流；河口或潮汐水道〔estero具體水域類型未定〕

queue_entries.source_L: riqueças ~ 〔舊候選id[疑:缩写]；下伸q樣及上小e/環筆，整個縮記未定，不展開〕. rico, ha / cienda ~
queue_entries.zh: 財富；富有的；財產〔縮記未解〕
queue_entries.en: Riches; rich; property or possessions [abbreviation unresolved].

queue_entries.source_L: Robar ~ 〔舊候選id[疑:缩写]；下伸q樣及上小e/環筆，整個縮記未定，不展開〕 hurtar.〔及L/H界〕
queue_entries.zh: 偷取、搶奪；偷竊〔縮記未解〕
queue_entries.en: To steal or rob; to steal [abbreviation unresolved].

queue_entries.source_L: Rociar con la boca 〔字栏左〕〔舊候選doluso；整個細字串未定〕. / imperceptible, bu⟨谷;v⟩.
queue_entries.zh: 用嘴噴灑；不易察覺的〔doluso候選細字未定〕
queue_entries.en: To sprinkle or spray with the mouth; imperceptible [small-letter doluso candidate unresolved].

queue_entries.source_L: Rodar. 〔舊候選id[疑:缩写]；下伸q樣及上小e/環筆，整個縮記未定，不展開〕. bueltas ~
queue_entries.zh: 滾動、轉動；圈轉〔縮記未解〕
queue_entries.en: To roll or turn; turns [abbreviation unresolved].

queue_entries.source_L: rodear, o rodeos del camº. 〔14—16的L共圈括〕
queue_entries.zh: 繞行、迂回〔末camº縮記未展〕
queue_entries.en: To go around or make detours [final camº abbreviation unexpanded].

queue_entries.source_L: Rodado ut las armas de fuego.
queue_entries.zh: 滾動、轉動的；如火器〔Rodado在此的具體所指未定〕
queue_entries.en: Rolled or revolving; as with firearms [the specific sense of Rodado here is unresolved].

queue_entries.zh: 有效地懇求；後文候讀「綁住手腳，而不能拒絕他／此事」（ata de pies y manos及代詞聯繫未定，不從H補義）
queue_entries.en: To entreat effectively; the following may read “binds hands and feet, and it cannot be denied him” (ata de pies y manos and the pronoun relations remain unresolved; H does not supply the reading).

queue_entries.zh: 候義：患鼻塞／鼻卡他者（Romadico原詞形及本處歷史義未核）
queue_entries.en: Tentative: a person with a head cold or nasal catarrh; the form Romadico and its historical sense here are unverified.

queue_entries.zh: 後詞catarro：卡他／鼻部傷風；romadico與縮記的聯繫未核
queue_entries.en: The following catarro: catarrh or a head cold; its relation to romadico and the abbreviation is unverified.

queue_entries.zh: 拆毀一個……；末詞tabladillo候讀，可指小型木板搭構，但字母與本處對象未定
queue_entries.en: To break by dismantling a …; the final word may read tabladillo, a small board-built structure, but its letters and the object here remain unresolved.

queue_entries.zh: 火的花／花狀火焰；與bomba的具體關係未核，不補煙火種類
queue_entries.en: A flower of fire or flower-like flame; its specific relation to bomba is unverified, and no firework type is supplied.

queue_entries.zh: 悲傷的；rostituerto候指面容不悅／歪斜，本處詞義未核
queue_entries.en: Sad; rostituerto may describe a displeased or distorted face, but its sense here is unverified.

queue_entries.zh: 性情不好的；rostituerto本處義未核
queue_entries.en: Ill-tempered; the sense of rostituerto here is unverified.

queue_entries.source_L: Sabalo
queue_entries.zh: sabalo所稱的魚〔只保留魚名，具體魚種未核，不以鰱魚代定〕
queue_entries.en: The fish called sabalo [the precise species is unverified; not identified from the Chinese column].

queue_entries.source_L: Saber [疑:fecta] mente
queue_entries.zh: 知道、懂得〔後續方式詞fecta候選未定〕
queue_entries.en: To know or understand [following manner expression, fecta candidate, unresolved].

queue_entries.source_L: Saber hacer algo — tiene juicio〔字形疑；自L跨H〕
queue_entries.zh: 知道如何做某件事〔後接tiene juicio細字候選未定〕
queue_entries.en: To know how to do something [following small-letter tiene juicio candidate unresolved].

queue_entries.source_L: Saber el offᵒ bien
queue_entries.zh: 熟知該offᵒ〔縮寫未展〕
queue_entries.en: To know the offᵒ well [abbreviation unexpanded].

queue_entries.zh: 天上靈體的智慧；後詞penetrar為深入／洞察（縮記與前後關係未定）
queue_entries.en: The wisdom of the spirits of heaven; the following penetrar means to penetrate or understand deeply, but the abbreviation and connection remain unresolved.

queue_entries.zh: 有智慧；後詞abil候指能幹（起首字母未定）；chang/mia音注另列不當Spanish
queue_entries.en: Wise; the following abil may mean able (its initial letters are unresolved). The chang/mia phonetic note is not treated as Spanish.

queue_entries.zh: 候義：善於謀劃／設計的人（tracista本處歷史義未核，不補職銜）
queue_entries.en: Tentative: one skilled in planning or designing; the historical sense of tracista here is unverified, and no office is supplied.

queue_entries.zh: 候義：一種吹奏樂器（Sacabuche；具體歷史種類未核）
queue_entries.en: Tentative: a wind instrument, Sacabuche; its specific historical type is unverified.

queue_entries.zh: 後詞trompeta：喇叭；前詞Sacabuche候為吹奏樂器，具體種類未核
queue_entries.en: The following trompeta: a trumpet; the preceding Sacabuche is tentatively a wind instrument, its specific type unverified.

queue_entries.zh: 像養蜂人那樣取得……（baratᵒ候讀及本處比喻義未核）
queue_entries.en: To obtain … like a beekeeper; the reading of baratᵒ and its figurative sense here are unverified.

queue_entries.zh: 取出熟飯；末詞候caço，可指杓／小鍋，字母及器形未核
queue_entries.en: To take out cooked rice; the final word may read caço, a ladle or small pan, but its letters and the vessel type are unverified.

queue_entries.zh: 母雞與蛋；sacar在此候指孵出，具體動作義未核，不依H補定
queue_entries.en: A hen and the eggs; sacar here may refer to hatching, but the action sense is unverified and is not supplied from H.

queue_entries.zh: 母雞與蛋；sacar在此候指孵出，具體動作義未核，不依H補定
queue_entries.en: A hen and the eggs; sacar here may refer to hatching, but the action sense is unverified and is not supplied from H.

queue_entries.source_L: Sacar el quarto & de diez〔本欄獨圈〕
queue_entries.zh: 取出四分之一〔原後& de diez的連接與比例關係未定，不計算成四成〕
queue_entries.en: To take out a quarter [the connection and ratio implied by the following & de diez are unresolved; not converted into forty percent].

queue_entries.source_L: Salir los lamparones
queue_entries.zh: 出現lamparones所稱的腫病〔保留歷史病名，未核定現代診斷〕
queue_entries.en: For the swellings called lamparones to appear [the historical disease term is retained; no modern diagnosis is identified].

queue_entries.source_L: Sacerdote que 〔acossa/acosa樣連串；舊acosta候選，中間s/t筆形及雙s數未定〕 a el diablo
queue_entries.zh: 祭司；其對魔鬼所作的動作未能定讀〔acossa/acosa/舊acosta候選不據義選定〕
queue_entries.en: A priest who [action verb unresolved] the devil [acossa/acosa and the older acosta remain candidates; the action is not selected by meaning].

queue_entries.source_L: [補寫] Saçon〔舊Sacon；第三字母下短筆/ç樣及覆筆仍須保留〕 - [刪字：重墨下未辨，不補] q〔上短斜/環樣，縮寫不展開〕 a buena oca / sion y saçon de comida
queue_entries.zh: 適當的時機；食物的適味、調味〔補寫首詞與被覆刪字未定〕
queue_entries.en: A suitable occasion; seasoning or a suitable taste of food [the supplemented first word and overwritten deleted text remain unresolved].

queue_entries.source_L: sacrificio q〔下伸q樣，上環/斜短筆；縮寫不展開〕 hace el Rey id est〔16–17L包線所及〕
queue_entries.zh: 國王所作的祭獻〔後接id est的說明關係未定，不從鄰條補天地〕
queue_entries.en: A sacrifice made by the king [the explanatory connection of the following id est is unresolved; heaven and earth are not supplied from the adjacent entry].

queue_entries.source_L: 〔17橫穿線左端與16–17包線下緣相連，右端接長弧；舊參考稿作西文橫劃刪，是否另有意刪除未定；deleted=null，不作確定未刪〕sacrificio q〔下伸q樣，上環/斜短筆；縮寫不展開〕 hace el Rey id est
queue_entries.zh: 國王所作的祭獻〔後接id est的說明關係未定；此L橫線是否刪除未定，不視為確定現行文字〕
queue_entries.en: A sacrifice made by the king [the explanatory connection of id est is unresolved; whether the crossing line deletes this L text is also unresolved, so it is not treated as certainly active text].

queue_entries.source_L: Sacristan de 〔nioma/xioma樣；首連筆及詞值未定，舊xioma[?]保留候選〕 en el / navio
queue_entries.zh: 船上與nioma/xioma候選詞相關的司事〔該詞讀法、所指未定〕
queue_entries.en: An attendant associated with the unresolved nioma/xioma word aboard a ship [the reading and referent of that word are unsettled].

queue_entries.source_L: sacudir açotar mui bien, si / le piden〔le/piden接筆仍保留；舊lapiden[?]〕 le pega
queue_entries.zh: 猛烈地擊打、鞭打；後串若讀作si le piden le pega，條件候選約為「若有人向某人要求，則有人擊打某人」〔句法、施受關係及代詞所指未定，不作確定事件敘述〕
queue_entries.en: To strike or whip very hard; if the following sequence is read as si le piden le pega, a conditional candidate is “if someone asks someone, someone strikes someone” [the construction, participants and pronoun referents remain unresolved; this is not a definite account].

queue_entries.source_L: sacudir a sus h〔長幹後上標o樣/環點未定，原縮寫不展開〕. y otros, vella / querias como estas
queue_entries.zh: 擊打自己的h後上標縮寫所指者及他人；諸如此類的卑劣行為〔不展作孩子；轉述原文貶評〕
queue_entries.en: To strike those denoted by the h-with-superscript abbreviation and others; such villainies [the abbreviation is not expanded as children; the evaluative wording belongs to the source].

queue_entries.source_L: [刪底行：Saya frutilla colorada〔中段覆墨，舊候選未逐字確定〕] / [下方另行未劃刪] Saya〔首字母S/Y樣、內部g/y連筆未定，舊Saya候選保留〕 frutilla colorada〔末串延H側〕
queue_entries.zh: 紅色的小果子〔未劃重寫行的首串未定〕
queue_entries.en: A small red fruit [the first word of the unstruck rewritten line is unresolved].

queue_entries.zh: 候義：發情的母犬（salida此搭配義未核）
queue_entries.en: Tentative: a female dog in heat; the sense of salida in this expression remains unverified.

queue_entries.zh: 候義：發情的母牛（baca原拼寫保留；salida此搭配義未核）
queue_entries.en: Tentative: a cow in heat; the spelling baca is retained, and the sense of salida here remains unverified.

queue_entries.zh: 泉水流出；末詞候saltando（躍出／跳動著），字母連筆未定
queue_entries.en: Water coming out of a spring; the final word may read saltando (leaping or springing), but the joined letters remain uncertain.

queue_entries.zh: 出去迎接；後句涉及與貨物的往來，具體聯繫未定
queue_entries.en: To go out to receive someone; the following phrase concerns dealings with merchandise, but its precise connection is unresolved.

queue_entries.zh: 若沒有別的出口，從窗戶或……出去；後詞候corredor（走廊），末字母未定
queue_entries.en: To go out through a window or … if there is no other way; the other word may read corredor (corridor), with its final letter uncertain.

queue_entries.zh: 把一切說出來；前半colada洗濯比喻的具體用法未核
queue_entries.en: To tell everything; the preceding colada washing metaphor is not fully established here.

queue_entries.zh: 從某項追求／請求中出來；後接mandarin（官員），兩者關係未定
queue_entries.en: To come out of a pursuit or petition; mandarin (an official) follows, but the relation is unresolved.

queue_entries.zh: 婦人排出……；pares候指胎衣／胎盤，其歷史用義未核
queue_entries.en: For women to expel …; pares may refer to the afterbirth, but the historical sense is unverified.

queue_entries.zh: 離開奴隸身分；後接官員一詞，pᵃ縮記及轉變關係原留未定
queue_entries.en: To leave the condition of a slave; the word for an official follows, while the pᵃ abbreviation and the transition remain unresolved.

queue_entries.zh: 候義：肛門處向外脫出（sieso在此歷史用義未核）
queue_entries.en: Tentative: protrusion at the anus; the historical use of sieso here remains unverified.

queue_entries.zh: 大的硝石；後串minero de sal與鹽礦相關，具體指稱未核
queue_entries.en: Large saltpeter; the following minero de sal concerns a salt mine or mining, but its exact referent is unverified.

queue_entries.zh: 黑色的血；後接oglut…mal候串，字形、分詞與義未定
queue_entries.en: Black blood; the following tentative string oglut…mal has unresolved letters, segmentation and meaning.

queue_entries.zh: 聖潔的／聖人；公正的；末詞候recto（正直的），字母及縮記未定
queue_entries.en: Holy or a saint; just; the final word may read recto (upright), with letters and abbreviation unresolved.

queue_entries.zh: 麻疹；發出／出現……；末縮記未展
queue_entries.en: Measles; to break out or appear …; the final abbreviation is unexpanded.

queue_entries.source_L: Salteador / saltar, ide〔末為3/曲折樣，舊idẽ縮寫候選；字值與展開未定〕
queue_entries.zh: 攔路搶劫者；另行saltar意為跳躍〔不改成saltear；ide末縮記及兩行關係未定〕
queue_entries.en: A highway robber; on the separate line, saltar means to jump [not changed to saltear; the final ide-like abbreviation and the relationship of the two lines remain unresolved].

queue_entries.source_L: salteador, desollador〔舊despellador；des後o樣連筆及ll相接，整詞保留候選〕.
queue_entries.zh: 搶劫者；後詞若讀desollador，可候選轉述為剝皮者〔整詞讀法未定，不據漢字欄補作剝削者〕
queue_entries.en: A robber; if the next word is desollador, a conditional paraphrase is a flayer [the reading is unresolved; an exploiter is not supplied from the Chinese column].

queue_entries.en: [Translation withheld: Saluadera is readable, but its historical meaning has not been established in this pass; no meaning is inferred from the Chinese or romanization.]

queue_entries.en: [Translation withheld: saluadera is readable, but its historical meaning has not been established in this pass; no meaning is inferred from the Chinese or romanization.]

queue_entries.source_L: saluados, grançones〔字形疑〕 —
queue_entries.zh: 麩皮；後接grançones候選詞未定〔不補定種類〕
queue_entries.en: Bran; the following grançones word remains a candidate [no particular type is supplied].

queue_entries.source_L: Saya saya
secar al humo — ofusco[?]
queue_entries.zh: 用煙熏乾〔後接ofusco舊候選未定〕
queue_entries.en: To dry with smoke [following ofusco candidate unresolved].

queue_entries.source_L: Secarse de todo la ...[疑 auergua]
queue_entries.zh: 完全乾涸〔後續字串未定〕
queue_entries.en: To dry up completely [following wording unresolved].

queue_entries.source_L: [上欄外] seguro. cierto.[?]
queue_entries.zh: 穩妥、安全的；後詞cierto若成立，為確實的〔後詞仍候選〕
queue_entries.en: Safe or secure; if the following candidate cierto is correct, certain [the second word remains unresolved].

queue_entries.source_L: sementera, vn quartel della / de 15 baras, p/q〔下伸雙斜幹及上小曲筆，舊p̃候選；縮寫不展開〕 la parte ~
queue_entries.zh: 播種地中的一塊區域、四分區；記有15 baras及la parte〔縮記及邊/部分關係未定，不換算面積〕
queue_entries.en: A section or quarter of sown land, with 15 baras and la parte specified [the abbreviated relation to a side or portion is unresolved; no area conversion is supplied].

queue_entries.source_L: Señal de q〔下伸曲幹、上角/長弧樣；舊q̃縮寫候選，不展開〕 madura o herida ~
queue_entries.zh: 傷痕；前段q樣縮記與madura連接未定，若為quemadura省寫則亦指燒傷痕〔原文不合併展寫〕
queue_entries.en: A mark from a wound; the preceding q-like abbreviation with madura is unresolved, but if it abbreviates quemadura it also denotes a burn mark [the original is not expanded or joined].

queue_entries.source_L: Señal de q〔下伸曲幹、上角/長弧樣；舊q̃縮寫候選，不展開〕 madura, o herida ~〔L獨圈〕
queue_entries.zh: 傷痕；前段q樣縮記與madura連接未定，若為quemadura省寫則亦指燒傷痕〔原文不合併展寫〕
queue_entries.en: A mark from a wound; the preceding q-like abbreviation with madura is unresolved, but if it abbreviates quemadura it also denotes a burn mark [the original is not expanded or joined].

queue_entries.source_L: Señal, dar la titolaficaya〔舊整詞候選；中段高幹/連筆與分詞未定，勿按現代詞形補定〕
queue_entries.zh: 記號、信物；給予某物〔dar後的整詞仍候選，不補定物件或習俗〕
queue_entries.en: A sign or token; to give something [the word following dar remains unresolved; no object or custom is supplied].

queue_entries.source_L: Señal de herida o q〔下伸曲幹、上角/長弧樣；舊q̃縮寫候選，不展開〕 madura
queue_entries.zh: 傷痕；另有q樣縮記與madura連接未定，若為quemadura省寫則亦指燒傷痕〔原文不合併展寫〕
queue_entries.en: A mark from a wound; the q-like abbreviation with madura is unresolved, but if it abbreviates quemadura it also denotes a burn mark [the original is not expanded or joined].

queue_entries.zh: 標記〔後續用途說明未定〕
queue_entries.en: A sign or mark [the following purpose clause is unresolved].

queue_entries.zh: 先生／尊稱；主教；中間P、S縮記未展，關係未定
queue_entries.en: Sir or lord; bishop; the intervening P and S abbreviations and their relationship remain unresolved.

queue_entries.zh: 尊稱；Padre（父親／宗教稱父者，本處關係未定）；S縮記原留
queue_entries.en: A respectful address; Padre, father or a religious form of address, with its relationship here unresolved; S is retained.

queue_entries.zh: 先生／尊稱；P縮記未展
queue_entries.en: Sir or lord; the P abbreviation is unexpanded.

queue_entries.zh: 對oficial的尊稱；oficial本處指官員或手藝人的用法未核
queue_entries.en: A respectful address to an oficial; whether an official or a craftsman is meant here is unverified.

queue_entries.en: To change suddenly, as the devil [ut provisionally understood as a comparative word].

queue_entries.source_L: trocar plata por chapas
queue_entries.zh: 把銀錢換成 chapas〔此處具體種類未定〕
queue_entries.en: To exchange silver money for chapas [the exact kind is unresolved here].

queue_entries.zh: 有實質力量的勇者〔sustancia具體義保留〕
queue_entries.en: A valiant person of substance; the precise sense of sustancia is retained as uncertain.

queue_entries.zh: 紙的一包或一捆；計數單位〔valon義候選〕
queue_entries.en: A bale or bundle of paper; a counting unit (valon interpretation tentative).

queue_entries.zh: 紙的一包或一捆及計數單位〔valon義候選〕
queue_entries.en: A bale or bundle of paper and a counting unit (valon interpretation tentative).

queue_entries.zh: 虛榮而標新立異的〔singular義候選〕
queue_entries.en: Vain and singular or eccentric (tentative sense of singular).

queue_entries.zh: 虛榮而標新立異的〔singular義候選〕
queue_entries.en: Vain and singular or eccentric (tentative sense of singular).

queue_entries.zh: 虛榮者，自稱屬於godos〔末詞及語用未定，不補貴族義〕
queue_entries.en: A vain person who presents himself as one of the godos; the last word and its implication remain uncertain.

queue_entries.zh: 箱子；另列arca、petaca〔petaca具體形制未定〕
queue_entries.en: A trunk; arca and petaca are also given (the precise type of petaca is not established).

queue_entries.zh: 禁止；附語字面為「做你的意願」〔句法關係未定〕
queue_entries.en: To forbid; the added clause literally concerns doing your will, but its relation to the verb is unresolved.

queue_entries.source_L: vieja noble, s.ʳᵃ vieja
queue_entries.zh: 年老的貴婦；年老的女士〔s.ʳᵃ縮寫按女士候讀〕
queue_entries.en: An elderly noblewoman; an elderly lady (s.ʳᵃ tentatively read as a title).

queue_entries.source_L: Viejo, vno q se fue al cielo es / cabeca de santos, otros [末詞未辨]
queue_entries.zh: 老人；一位去了天上、是諸聖之首的人；otros＝其他的〔後詞未辨，句意未完〕
queue_entries.en: An old man; one who went to heaven and is head of the saints; otros means others/other [following word unread; sentence incomplete].

queue_entries.source_L: Viejo con muchos bienes
queue_entries.zh: 擁有很多財物／好處的老人〔bienes範圍保留〕
queue_entries.en: An old man with many possessions / good things (scope of bienes retained).

queue_entries.source_L: viento grande. Vagio
queue_entries.zh: 大風；Vagio〔詞義候選：風暴，詞形不改〕
queue_entries.en: A strong wind; Vagio [possibly a storm term; spelling retained].

queue_entries.source_L: Viento q pasa vt toruellino
queue_entries.zh: 如旋風般吹過的風〔vt按比較用語候解〕
queue_entries.en: A wind passing like a whirlwind (vt tentatively treated as a comparison).

queue_entries.source_L: Viento Baguio
queue_entries.zh: 風；Baguio〔風暴／颱風類候義，不據H定名〕
queue_entries.en: Wind; Baguio [tentatively a storm/typhoon term, not inferred from H].

queue_entries.source_L: Viga, arique
queue_entries.zh: 梁；arique〔詞義未確定，保留〕
queue_entries.en: A beam; arique [meaning unresolved].

queue_entries.source_L: viga llaues del edificio
queue_entries.zh: 梁，建築物的鍵結構件〔llaues字面為鍵；構件細義候解〕
queue_entries.en: A beam; key/tie members of a building (technical function tentative).

queue_entries.source_L: viguetas o baraquilos del texado
queue_entries.zh: 屋頂的小梁或椽條〔baraquilos細義候解〕
queue_entries.en: Small roof beams or rafters (precise baraquilos sense tentative).

queue_entries.source_L: Viguetas o varaquilos
queue_entries.zh: 小梁或椽條〔varaquilos細義候解〕
queue_entries.en: Small beams or rafters (precise varaquilos sense tentative).

queue_entries.source_L: Viguetas o baraquilos
queue_entries.zh: 小梁或椽條〔baraquilos細義候解〕
queue_entries.en: Small beams or rafters (precise baraquilos sense tentative).

queue_entries.source_L: Viguela pequeña
queue_entries.zh: 小型viguela弦樂器〔不與箏強行等同〕
queue_entries.en: A small viguela stringed instrument (not equated with H: zheng).

queue_entries.source_L: viguela de arco
queue_entries.zh: 用弓拉奏的viguela弦樂器〔不與琶強行等同〕
queue_entries.en: A bowed viguela stringed instrument (not equated with H).

queue_entries.source_L: Viguela de arco
queue_entries.zh: 用弓拉奏的viguela弦樂器〔不與琵琶強行等同〕
queue_entries.en: A bowed viguela stringed instrument (not equated with H: pipa).

queue_entries.source_L: viguela de 4 ordenes
queue_entries.zh: 四組弦的viguela弦樂器〔ordenes按弦組候解，不作四根弦〕
queue_entries.en: A viguela with four courses (ordenes tentatively courses, not four individual strings).

queue_entries.source_L: viguela de muchas ordenes
queue_entries.zh: 多組弦的viguela弦樂器
queue_entries.en: A viguela with many courses of strings.

queue_entries.source_L: viguela de muchas ordenes

queue_entries.en: A viguela with many courses of strings.

queue_entries.en: An idol with horns who was a learned man; candidate reading of letra / do as letrado.

queue_entries.zh: 女性偶像，被人奉祀；比較對象縮寫及末串未譯
queue_entries.en: A female idol who is worshipped; the abbreviated comparison and final small text remain untranslated.

queue_entries.zh: 蛋黃；堅果的仁、手指與眼的yema〔後兩用法只列對象，不由仁倒推〕
queue_entries.en: Yolk of an egg; yema of a nut, finger and eye; the last two senses are not resolved here.

queue_entries.zh: 草；用途短語未定，未譯

queue_entries.source_L: ynquieto coraçon con desone- / stidades〔分行交界字母仍疑〕
queue_entries.zh: 內心因不端之事而不安〔desone-/stidades讀法候選〕
queue_entries.en: Uneasy at heart over indecencies [reading of the split final word remains tentative].

queue_entries.source_L: Inquietud grandissima / q̃ no dexa viuir
queue_entries.zh: 極度不安，以至不得安生〔q̃未展開〕
queue_entries.en: Extreme unrest that does not let one live in peace [q̃ unexpanded].

queue_entries.source_L: Inquirir q̃ preguntar. abiriguar〔末詞中段連筆，候選〕〔preguntar後段及abiriguar跨H至M左緣〕
queue_entries.zh: 查問、詢問、查明〔縮寫及末詞拼字候選〕
queue_entries.en: To inquire, ask, or ascertain [abbreviation and final spelling unresolved].

queue_entries.source_L: ynquirir. q̃. preguntar〔各L單圈；非刪文〕
queue_entries.zh: 查問、詢問〔q̃未展開〕
queue_entries.en: To inquire or ask [q̃ unexpanded].

queue_entries.source_L: ynquirir, tomar residen- / cia
queue_entries.zh: 查究；進行residencia式官員任職審查〔制度細節未譯〕
queue_entries.en: To investigate; to conduct a residencia review of an official's service [institutional details withheld].

queue_entries.source_L: Instar cuidar. q̃. cuidado.
queue_entries.zh: 持續用心、照料；謹慎／關照〔q̃未展開〕
queue_entries.en: To persist or attend to; care [q̃ unexpanded].

queue_entries.source_L: ynstituir. q̃ hazer.〔q上小e形；末詞連筆〕
queue_entries.zh: 設立；製作〔q̃未展開〕
queue_entries.en: To institute; to make [q̃ unexpanded].

queue_entries.source_L: ynterceder por ser amigo / y poder con el. q̃. rogar.
queue_entries.zh: 因是朋友且對他有影響力而代求；懇求〔q̃未展開〕
queue_entries.en: To intercede because one is a friend and has influence with him; to entreat [q̃ unexpanded].

queue_entries.source_L: Interessable
queue_entries.zh: 可被利益打動、逐利的〔Interessable語義範圍候選〕
queue_entries.en: Open to being moved by self-interest; mercenary [semantic range tentative].

queue_entries.source_L: ynteresable〔L單圈；非刪文〕
queue_entries.zh: 可被利益打動、逐利的〔語義範圍候選〕
queue_entries.en: Open to being moved by self-interest; mercenary [semantic range tentative].

queue_entries.source_L: ynteresable, solo obra / por interes. q̃. codicia.
queue_entries.zh: 逐利，只為利益行事；貪欲〔q̃未展開〕
queue_entries.en: Self-interested, acting only for gain; greed [q̃ unexpanded].

queue_entries.source_L: ynterprete naguatato〔18–20 L共圈；非刪文〕
queue_entries.zh: 口譯者；naguatato〔未確證術語，原詞保留；不外推族群或語言〕
queue_entries.en: An interpreter; naguatato [unverified term retained; no ethnicity or language is assigned].

queue_entries.source_L: Interrumpir la buena / amistad - q̃. diuidir, cortar…〔末尾連筆未定〕
queue_entries.zh: 破壞良好友誼；分開、切斷……〔縮寫及末尾未定〕
queue_entries.en: To interrupt a good friendship; divide or sever… [abbreviation and ending unresolved].

queue_entries.source_L: Ynuentariar. q̃. apreciar, / precio. sec…star〔中段連筆未定；舊secuestrar僅候選〕
queue_entries.zh: 編列清單；估價、價格；末詞未定〔q̃未展開〕
queue_entries.en: To inventory; appraise, price; final word unresolved [q̃ unexpanded].

queue_entries.source_L: Ynuisible - ut sup…〔末縮寫連筆未定；跨L/H〕
queue_entries.zh: 不可見的；如上〔ut sup…縮寫尾形未定，未補展原文〕
queue_entries.en: Invisible; as above [ut sup… has an unresolved abbreviation ending; the source is not expanded].
